verdict.rationale: While Nix flakes could in principle be used to compose multiple local packages with a shared flake.lock, the evidence pack contains no mention of workspaces, monorepo support, or cross-linked local package dependencies — only single-package flake/build/dev commands are documented. missing for 10: any mention of multi-package flake composition, workspace-style local path inputs, or shared lockfile across sub-projects.
